theorem lg_target {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hΓ : ∃ h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods, 0 < h) {a b : ℤ} {f : ModularForm Γ a} {g : ModularForm Γ b} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : f.mul g ≠ 0 := by
  intro hfg
  contrapose! hfg
  intros hfg0
  apply not_not_elim
  intro hfg0'
  have h_coe_mul : ⇑(f.mul g) = ⇑f * ⇑g := ModularForm.coe_mul f g
  have h_zero : ⇑f * ⇑g = 0 := by rw [h_coe_mul, hfg0']
  cases h_zero with h_zero_f h_zero_g
  left
  apply hf
  intro z hz
  contraposet
  intro hzf
  have h_zero_f' : ⇑f = 0 := by rw [hzf, zero_mul]
  apply not_iff_not.mp hf
  exact h_zero_f'
  right
  apply hg
  intro z hz
  contraposet
  intro hzg
  have h_zero_g' : ⇑g = 0 := by rw [hzg, mul_zero]
  apply not_iff_not.mp hg
  exact h_zero_g'
